The Moon is bright (about 82% illuminated), and civil twilight would not by itself prevent you from seeing it if it were above the horizon. But brightness cannot overcome being several degrees below it. Terrain, buildings, or local horizon obstructions would only make it less possible.

So you can safely take relief: from Reykjavík at **10:31 UTC on 20 December 2026**, the Moon would be **not visible**.
